in_marathi.name: Jayu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jayu is derived from the Sanskrit root 'jay' meaning victory or triumph. In Hindu mythology, Jayu is a name for Lord Vishnu, symbolizing his power and victory over evil.
